dialogue.text: Spring months is the 8th of the 24 solar tons.
dialogue.zh: 春季節氣是二十四節氣中的第八個。
dialogue.ja: 春の節気は二十四節気の中で8番目です。
dialogue.local: Spring months is the 8th of the 24 solar tons.
dialogue.en: Spring months is the 8th of the 24 solar tons.

dialogue.text: This year it falls on May 21st.
dialogue.zh: 今年它落在五月二十一日。
dialogue.ja: 今年は5月21日にあたります。
dialogue.local: This year it falls on May 21st.
dialogue.en: This year it falls on May 21st.

dialogue.text: As its Chinese name, Xiaomi suggests, it is a period of time when greens are beginning to ripen but not quite there yet.
dialogue.zh: 正如它的中文名字“小滿”所暗示的，這是一段綠色植物開始成熟但尚未完全成熟的時期。
dialogue.ja: 中国語の名前「小満」が示すように、緑の植物が成熟し始めるけれど、まだ完全ではない時期です。
dialogue.local: As its Chinese name, Xiaomi suggests, it is a period of time when greens are beginning to ripen but not quite there yet.
dialogue.en: As its Chinese name, Xiaomi suggests, it is a period of time when greens are beginning to ripen but not quite there yet.

dialogue.text: During this period, some are forced throughout the whole country, while precipitation increases.
dialogue.zh: 在這段期間，全國各地會有一些強制性的措施，同時降水量增加。
dialogue.ja: この期間中、全国でいくつかの強制的な措置があり、降水量も増えます。
dialogue.local: During this period, some are forced throughout the whole country, while precipitation increases.
dialogue.en: During this period, some are forced throughout the whole country, while precipitation increases.

dialogue.text: China is a vast country with different landscapes.
dialogue.zh: 中國是一個幅員遼闊、地貌多樣的國家。
dialogue.ja: 中国は広大で多様な風景を持つ国です。
dialogue.local: China is a vast country with different landscapes.
dialogue.en: China is a vast country with different landscapes.

dialogue.text: During this solar ton, we can experience coolness in the northern enjoying the summer sunshine in the southern and admire the snowy mountains and the Qinghai Tibet battle.
dialogue.zh: 在這個節氣期間，我們可以在北方感受到涼爽，在南方享受夏日陽光，並欣賞雪山和青藏高原的美景。
dialogue.ja: この節気の間、北部では涼しさを感じ、南部では夏の陽光を楽しみ、雪山や青蔵高原の景色を鑑賞できます。
dialogue.local: During this solar ton, we can experience coolness in the northern enjoying the summer sunshine in the southern and admire the snowy mountains and the Qinghai Tibet battle.
dialogue.en: During this solar ton, we can experience coolness in the northern enjoying the summer sunshine in the southern and admire the snowy mountains and the Qinghai Tibet battle.
